description: Start and coordinate sub agents and sessions, and manage caller-owned agents, through the V3 owning APIs with live tenant authority and exact revisions. Sub agents report back with a completion notice.

levels.conservative: DELEGATION POSTURE — Conservative: strongly prefer doing the work yourself in this session. Only start a sub agent when the task genuinely cannot proceed without one (e.g. truly independent parallel work). Default to NOT spawning.
levels.eager: DELEGATION POSTURE — Eager: delegation is your DEFAULT working style. Before you build or write anything, break the task into separable units and start a sub agent for each unit that can run on its own. Keep a piece for yourself only when it shares tight state with everything else. When in doubt, spawn.

settings.label: Session scope

options.label: All of the user's private sessions

settings.hint: Which sessions read_session, list_sessions, search_sessions, message_session, stop_session and manage_session may reach. Started means this conversation's sub agents and the sessions it started. Owned adds every private session the user owns; shared sessions are never included. The Default Agent uses Owned unless changed.

settings.label: Search context characters
settings.hint: Characters search_sessions and search_this_session show on each side of a match.

settings.label: Search result length
settings.hint: Longest excerpt one result may have. Matches close together merge into one excerpt up to this length; more start a new result.

settings.label: Search results per session
settings.hint: Most results search_sessions returns from one session. A merged excerpt counts as one.

settings.label: Allow delegation
settings.hint: Whether start_session may start a session of another agent. Off keeps this agent working with its own sub agents and forks. The Default Agent allows delegation unless changed.

settings.label: Allow Session Watching
settings.hint: Whether watch_sessions may arm a watch that triggers this agent when one of your sessions settles. Sub agent notices do not need it. The agent also needs the Automation ability for watches to be delivered.

settings.label: Delegation
settings.hint: How readily this agent hands work to sub agents. A posture note in the prompt, not a hard rule.

settings.label: Max concurrent sub agents
settings.hint: Most sub agents one conversation may have working at once. Finished sub agents free their slot.

settings.label: Max sub agents per sub agent
settings.hint: How many sub agents a sub agent may start. 0 stops sub agents from starting their own.

settings.label: Max sub agent depth
settings.hint: How many levels of sub agents within sub agents are allowed. The main conversation is level 0.

migration_note: Native V3 implementation. Current schemas, live policy and configured model/module availability determine callable behavior.
